labels.label: def:egf

hypotheses.paper: S a Riemannian manifold endowed with its volume measure lambda (main.tex:217)
hypotheses.note: the witnesses live on R/Z and on the flat torus T^2 = UnitAddTorus (Fin 2) with Haar measure, which is the Riemannian volume of the flat metric; IsOpenPosMeasure (full support) is proved for T^2 (CatFixed.isEGFErgodic_not_isEGF).

the rotation by sqrt 2 and the identity of R/Z (C-50); the cat map x -> [[2,1],[1,1]]x of T^2, both as a measurable equivalence (CatFixed.move) and as a homeomorphism (CatFixed.homeo), the same map (coe_move, coe_homeo, both rfl).

hypotheses.paper: a policy alpha : S -> [0,1]^p (main.tex:221; C-27: measurable, sum alpha^i = 1)
hypotheses.note: alpha = (0, 1) for C-50 (a zero weight, which C-27's corrected text allows, the point of C-50); alpha = 1 for the cat map.

findings: main.tex:222, :277, :775 (C-50, proved): read with Definition 3.1's ergodicity (DEC-146: the group generated by the moves ergodic for lambda), 'pi* ergodic' makes C-29's corrected Theorems 3.4 and B.1 false (the printed ones assume summable mixing and stand). On R/Z with Haar measure, Phi = (sqrt 2 + ., id) and alpha = (0, 1), the flow (pi, lambda) is an EGF in DEC-146's sense (the group contains the ergodic rotation, EGF.isGroupErgodic_of_ergodic_mem), lambda is invariant, and the kernel is the identity (EGF.ZeroWeight.policy_eq_id): not ergodic (the half circle [-1/4, 1/4] is invariant, of measure 1/2) and not universal (EGF.ZeroWeight.isEGFErgodic_not_isKernelErgodic). Every flow on it has defect exactly ||F_init - F_term||_TV whatever its outflow (EGF.ZeroWeight.errors_eq_tvMass_policy), and no family on it with outflows << lambda is epsilon-universal (EGF.ZeroWeight.not_isUniversalFamilyEps). The readings are stated as Props and refuted: EGF.Theorem34GroupReading (lambda finite; a family of EGFs, every member an EGF in DEC-146's sense, containing (pi*, f lambda) for every f of a set D dense in the non-negative cone of L2, pi* the kernel of an EGF in DEC-146's sense with lambda itself invariant, is epsilon-universal; EGF.not_theorem34GroupReading, at the family of ALL flows on pi with outflows << lambda and D = L2(lambda), dense in all of L2) and EGF.TheoremB1GroupReading (the kernel of such an EGF is a universal policy; EGF.not_theoremB1GroupReading). With positive weights both readings hold (EGF.theorem34GroupReading_of_pos, EGF.theoremB1GroupReading_of_pos), which is C-50's added hypothesis for the converse, shown necessary.

main.tex:219-221 (C-26, proved, in the paper's exact setting): on the flat torus T^2 with its volume (Haar, of full support), the cat map x -> [[2,1],[1,1]]x with weight 1 is an EGF in DEC-146's sense whose kernel is a universal policy, and it is topologically ergodic neither for its group nor with forward words, hence not an EGF in the printed sense (EGF.IsEGF, whose policy clause holds): it fixes 0, and a common fixed point rules out both topological readings on a T1 space with a second point (EGF.not_isTopologicallyErgodicGroup_of_fixed). Statement: EGF.CatFixed.isEGFErgodic_not_isEGF. This removes the 'not of full support' limit of EGF.isEGFErgodic_not_isEGF (delta_true on Bool), as the def-egf auditor's follow-up proposed; with EGF.isEGF_not_isEGFErgodic (whose measure is not the volume) only the other direction still lacks a witness in the exact setting (Furstenberg, not formalized).
questions: Reading taken for C-50's refuted form (not a question for the author: C-50 is ruled under DEC-141): 'pi* ergodic for a finite invariant measure equivalent to lambda' (C-29's Theorem 3.4 and B.1) read with Definition 3.1's ergodicity means 'pi* is the kernel of an EGF in DEC-146's sense, the moves' group ergodic for lambda-hat'; the Props take lambda-hat = lambda itself invariant, the most favourable case, so their refutation covers every lambda-hat.

labels.label: cor:pinsker_negative_control

hypotheses.note: a probability measure on states, E_{nu_train} = integral against it, as EGF/Loss.lean reads it; the witness takes nu_train = delta_true.
every b in R: the loss of the witness does not depend on b (the weak-FM term vanishes).

hypotheses.paper: the weak-FM term 'controls' delta/(1+delta) (main.tex:407) and the normalization (main.tex:425)
hypotheses.note: the weakest form of 'controls': a vanishing weak-FM term forces delta = 0 (EGF.WeakFMControlPrinted). Every quantitative reading delta/(1+delta) <= g(E_{nu_train} delta f_init) with g(0) = 0 implies it.

findings: main.tex:366, :407, :425 (C-58, proved): for an arbitrary training distribution the weak-FM term controls nothing. On Bool with the counting measure lambda, nu_train = delta_true (lambda is not << nu_train, EGF.SwapM.not_count_ac_dirac_true), the flow EGF.SwapM.flow m (the swap, F_out = m delta_false) and F_init = kappa = delta_true: E_{nu_train} delta f_init = delta f_init(true) = 0 (EGF.SwapM.weakFM_dirac_true; the defect at true is 1 + m) while delta = m (EGF.SwapM.delta_eq) and the normalization is 1 + m (EGF.SwapM.integral_ftermHat_eq, against l.425); the loss is -log(1 + m) for every b (EGF.SwapM.loss_dirac_true), below H(kappa) = 0 as soon as m > 0 (EGF.SwapM.loss_dirac_true_lt_entropy) and tending to -infinity while delta tends to +infinity (EGF.SwapM.loss_dirac_true_tendsto_bot).

main.tex:407 in its weakest form ('a vanishing weak-FM term forces delta = 0', under every presupposition: F_init, F_out, F_in, kappa << lambda, kappa of finite entropy, a finite loss) is false (EGF.not_weakFMControlPrinted); it holds under C-58's hypotheses lambda << nu_train and ||d lambda/d nu_train||_inf < infinity, quantitatively delta/(1 + delta) <= min(1, N E_{nu_train} delta f_init) (EGF.weakFM_controls_defect, EGF.weakFMControl_of_ac).

C-58's hypothesis hnuT (lambda << nu_train) of EGF.loss_controls_sampling_essSup is necessary, even with hM: the witness satisfies every other hypothesis of that theorem, including hM (||d count/d delta_true||_{L^inf(delta_true)} < infinity, EGF.SwapM.essSup_rnDeriv_count_dirac_true_ne_top) and b >= 1 + N, and its floor H(kappa) <= L fails (EGF.LossFloorWithoutAC, EGF.not_lossFloorWithoutAC). Whether hM is necessary given hnuT is not settled here.
questions: Reading taken: 'controls' at main.tex:407 and :425 read in its weakest form (EGF.WeakFMControlPrinted); its refutation refutes every quantitative reading, so no ruling is needed. nu_train is read as a probability on states, as in EGF/Loss.lean.

labels.label: theo:universality_true

hypotheses.paper: (S, lambda) a measured Polish space, pi* a Markov kernel (main.tex:775)
hypotheses.note: the witness space is T^d = UnitAddTorus (Fin d), d >= 1, with Haar measure; pi* the kernel of x -> x + c.
c drawn from Haar measure: the statements hold for almost every c (universality); the non-mixing holds for every c.

findings: main.tex:697, :702 (C-29, C-56, proved in every dimension): on T^d, d >= 1, for almost every c the kernel of the translation x -> x + c is a universal policy and is not summably L2-mixing (EGF.ae_isUniversalPolicy_not_isSummablyL2Mixing_tori); its fixed-policy family {pi_c} x L2_+(lambda) is epsilon-universal and contains no summably L2-mixing policy (EGF.ae_universalFamily_not_summablyMixing_tori). l.697's parenthetical ('one randomly initialized non-trainable translation is sufficient to ensure ergodicity') holds in every dimension, with universality, while 'L2-mixing summability needed for universality' (l.697) and 'essential to ensure universality' (l.702) are false in every dimension in the reading 'necessary'. No translation of T^d, d >= 1, is summably mixing (EGF.not_isSummablyL2Mixing_torus_translation, any c). Extends EGF.universal_not_summablyMixing_addCircle and EGF.universalFamily_not_summablyMixing_addCircle from d = 1.

main.tex:775 (C-50, see def:egf): Theorem B.1's sufficiency with 'ergodic' read as Definition 3.1's group ergodicity is false (EGF.not_theoremB1GroupReading); true with positive weights (EGF.theoremB1GroupReading_of_pos).

corrections.notes: The refutation the entry names as 'aim (1) of T-egf-correction-witnesses': the printed reading as Props EGF.Theorem34GroupReading and EGF.TheoremB1GroupReading, each refuted at the zero-weight EGF of R/Z (EGF.ZeroWeight.flow). Supporting: EGF.ZeroWeight.errors_eq_tvMass_policy (the defect is ||F_init - F_term|| for every outflow, the entry's sentence), EGF.ZeroWeight.not_isUniversalFamilyEps. The two _of_pos theorems are not anchors of the corrected definition (that is EGF.IsKernelErgodic and the entry's anchors); they show that the entry's added hypothesis (positive weights for the converse) is what saves the group reading, and ZeroWeight.isEGFErgodic_not_isKernelErgodic that it cannot be dropped. Sorry-free, standard axioms. C-50's label field is theo:universality (main.tex:277), outside this dispatch's label list: the master decides where these decls are listed.

To add beside EGF.isEGFErgodic_not_isEGF: the converse direction of C-26's finding (DEC-146's ergodicity does not give topological ergodicity) in the paper's exact setting (flat T^2, its volume of full support, a diffeomorphism), with a universal kernel. Supporting lemma EGF.not_isTopologicallyErgodicGroup_of_fixed. C-26's status and corrected text are unaffected.

The refutation the entry names as 'aim (3)'. Supporting: EGF.SwapM.weakFM_dirac_true, EGF.SwapM.integral_ftermHat_eq (l.425's normalization), EGF.SwapM.not_count_ac_dirac_true, EGF.SwapM.loss_dirac_true_lt_entropy, EGF.SwapM.essSup_rnDeriv_count_dirac_true_ne_top (the witness satisfies hM). The printed forms as Props: EGF.WeakFMControlPrinted (l.407, l.425 in the weakest form of 'controls') and EGF.LossFloorWithoutAC (EGF.loss_controls_sampling_essSup's floor without hnuT). The anchors complement the entry's existing ones (EGF.loss_controls_sampling_essSup, loss_controls_defect, integral_le_mul_of_le_smul, negMass_ratio_le_min): l.407's control in the corrected text's own hypotheses (lambda << nu_train, ||d lambda/d nu_train||_inf < infinity). Once graduated the entry can move from found to proved (the master's field).

Universal non-mixing witnesses in every dimension d >= 1 (the entry's refutation of 'mixing is needed', l.697, l.702, so far at d = 1 and on Bool). Supporting: EGF.not_isSummablyL2Mixing_torus_translation, EGF.isUniversalPolicy_torus_translation_of_ergodic, EGF.unitMeanZero_volume_torus_nonempty.

l.697's parenthetical in every dimension with universality (as EGF.ae_universality_tori_translation) and, new, with the non-mixing of the very translation it names: 'L2-mixing summability ... which universality does not need' (the corrected text) is witnessed in every dimension.

kb_proposals: A measure on a coordinate set of UnitAddTorus (Fin d): MeasureTheory.measurePreserving_eval (fun _ => (volume : Measure UnitAddCircle)) i (the global volume is Measure.pi by definition), then .measurable hB and .measure_preimage hB.nullMeasurableSet, with the set written {x | x i ∈ B}: `Function.eval i ⁻¹' B` fails to elaborate (the dependent codomain stays a metavariable) and `measurable_pi_apply i hB` mis-unifies (EGF.unitMeanZero_volume_torus_nonempty).

Pitfalls at this pin: Nontrivial UnitAddCircle is not an instance (exists_ne fails; a nonzero point is ((1/2 : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) by AddCircle.coe_eq_zero_iff, push_cast, exact_mod_cast and omega); MeasurableEquiv.coe_refl does not exist (the coe of MeasurableEquiv.refl is id by rfl: `exact MeasurePreserving.id _`); essSup against a Dirac mass: rw [ae_dirac_eq] and Filter.eventually_pure (MeasurableSingletonClass), with Measure.rnDeriv_lt_top for finiteness.

Witness patterns: a zero weight makes egfKernel the identity kernel, an EGF in DEC-146's sense never kernel-ergodic (EGF.ZeroWeight); a common fixed point of the moves rules out both topological readings (EGF.not_isTopologicallyErgodicGroup_of_fixed), and a hyperbolic toral automorphism fixes 0; a Homeomorph from torusAffineEquiv A b hA with continuous_torusAffine for A and for A⁻¹ (EGF.CatFixed.homeo); on Bool, every measure is ≪ count (Measure.count_eq_zero_iff).
